questions.stem: What is the transition state (activated complex) on a reaction profile?

options.text: The highest energy point where old bonds are partially broken and new bonds are partially formed
The energy level of the products
The point where the reactants are first mixed
The point where the reaction reaches equilibrium

questions.explanation: The transition state (or activated complex) is the highest energy point on the reaction profile. At this point, the old bonds in the reactants are partially broken and the new bonds in the products are partially formed. It is an unstable arrangement that exists only momentarily.
